lines.en: Drifts, echoes in the night breeze.
In the long night, I roam.
Flickers in darkness, I never stop.
Walks in the void, seeking host.
Servant of the虚视者, endless night.

lines.zh: 我穿行在骨荒原的碎骨间。
lines.en: I glide through the shattered bones of the waste.

lines.zh: 血肉平原上，我无声滑行。
lines.en: Across the flesh plains I slide, silent.

lines.zh: 我屏息，等你再多看一眼。
lines.en: I hold still, waiting for one more glance.

lines.zh: 基岩裂缝下，我静静悬浮。
lines.en: Beneath the bedrock crack I hang, still.

lines.zh: 我数着你的目光，一秒一秒。
lines.en: I count your gaze, second by second.

lines.zh: 虚视者的惩罚，暂歇片刻。
lines.en: The Spectrals' punishment rests a while.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓在黑暗里淡去。
lines.en: My outline fades into the dark.
No breath, no heartbeat, only waiting.

lines.zh: 你无法从我的视线中逃脱。
你的命运在于我的凝视。
lines.en: Your fate is in my gaze.

lines.zh: 我的凝视将带给你恐惧。
我的凝视将成你的噩梦。
lines.en: My gaze will be your nightmare.

lines.zh: 我的存在将成你的恶梦。
lines.en: My presence will be your nightmare.
One more look at me and I take shape.

lines.zh: 你的目光把我拉到这里。
lines.en: Your gaze is what dragged me here.
Before you blink, I am behind you.
Do not look away. I move when you do.

lines.zh: 我看见你藏在眼里的恐惧。
lines.en: I see the fear hiding behind your eyes.
You stare into the void, and it stares back.

lines.zh: 我的脸贴在你的噩梦里。
lines.en: My face is pressed against your nightmare.

lines.zh: 你的瞳孔里已经有我了。
lines.en: I am already inside your pupils.

lines.zh: 久看必生我，你忘了规则。
lines.en: Stare too long and I am born. You forgot.

lines.zh: 我记住了你眼睛的形状。
lines.en: I have memorized the shape of your eyes.
The phantom in the void suffers!

lines.zh: 你的光芒刺痛了我，鬼魅梦魇咆哮道。
lines.en: Your light burns me, the Ghostly Nightmare roared.

lines.zh: 你的食物将滋养我的虚视者。
lines.en: Your flesh will nourish the Spectrals.

lines.zh: 你手里的火光，把我的影子喂大。
lines.en: The light in your hand feeds my shadow.

lines.zh: 我的存在是永恒的恐惧。
你的梦境将成为我的养料。
你注定要成为我的食粮。
lines.en: You are destined to be my prey.

lines.zh: 我的虚视者之眼能看透一切。
lines.en: My Spectral eyes see through all.
You dare to collide with me!

lines.zh: 你穿过我，像穿过一阵冷风。
lines.en: You pass through me like a gust of cold air.

lines.zh: 虚视者的触碰无法伤害。
lines.en: The touch of the Spectrals cannot harm.
You looked too long; that's why I came.

lines.zh: 我的虚视者之身坚不可摧。

lines.en: You are but a phantom existence.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣将拥有你的灵魂。
lines.en: My partner will claim your soul.

lines.zh: 我们的力量将合二为一。
lines.en: Our powers will merge into one.

lines.zh: 我们的虚视者之眼注视你。
lines.en: Our Spectral eyes are upon you.

lines.zh: 我们的存在无法被忽视。
我们的虚视者之身将吞噬你。
lines.en: Our Spectral bodies will consume you.

lines.zh: 我们的力量将守护彼此。
lines.en: Our power will protect each other.

lines.zh: 我们的虚视者之魂将永生。
lines.en: Our Spectral souls will live forever.

lines.zh: 你的影子消失在虚空中。
lines.en: Your shadow vanishes into the void.

lines.zh: 鬼魅梦魇吞噬你的灵魂。
虚视者夺走你的生命力。
你感受到虚视者的凝视。
lines.en: You feel the void wraith's gaze.
Void wraith appears from the darkness.

lines.zh: 你的灵魂被虚视者抓住。
lines.en: Your soul is grabbed by the void wraith.

lines.zh: 虚视者吸取你的生命力。
lines.en: Void wraith drains your life force.
Void wraith lets out a piercing scream.

lines.zh: 我数完你的脚步，才落到地上。
lines.en: I finish counting your steps before touching down.

lines.zh: 你看得太久，所以我来了。
lines.en: You stared too long, so I came.

lines.zh: 被凝视太久，我才被引来。
lines.en: Stared at too long, I was drawn here.

lines.zh: 骨荒原的风把你的气味送来。
lines.en: The wind off the bone wastes carries your scent.
I smell the warmth of something alive.
On the bone waste, only you move.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的那一瞬，我记下了。
lines.en: I marked the instant you blinked.
Your footsteps reach me under the crack.
I move my gaze onto you.
It fixes its gaze on you.

lines.zh: 我贴在你视线的边角，不离开。
lines.en: I cling to the edge of your vision and stay.
You stared too long, so I came.
You step back, I step closer.
A gaze like bone splinters pins you.
I cling to the edge of your sight.
Do not turn. I am right there.

lines.zh: 你的名字在虚空里回响。
lines.en: Your name echoes in the void.

lines.zh: 我已经围着你走了一圈。
lines.en: I have already circled you once.

lines.zh: 火光里，只有我站着不动。
lines.en: In the torchlight, only I stand still.
The more you look, the closer I get.

lines.zh: 血肉平原的风停了，为谁？
lines.en: The flesh plains' wind stopped. For whom?

lines.zh: 你盯得太久，把我引来了。
lines.en: You stared too long — that summoned me.

lines.zh: 你感受到它的冰冷气息
鬼魅般的手指掠过你的皮肤
lines.en: Its ghostly fingers brush your skin.
Its howl tears through the night.

lines.zh: 你的心脏在它的凝视下颤抖
lines.en: Your heart trembles under its gaze.

lines.zh: 它苍白的触碰令你窒息
它的存在令四周的一切扭曲
它的触碰仿佛冰冷的阴影
lines.en: Its touch feels like a cold shadow.

lines.zh: 它从你的恐惧中汲取力量
我的指头穿过你的护甲，停在胸口。
lines.en: My fingers pass through your armor and stop at your chest.

lines.zh: 我把噩梦按进你脑子里。
lines.en: I press the nightmare into your skull.

lines.zh: 寒气先到，痛觉慢了半拍。
lines.en: The cold arrives first; the pain lags half a beat.
Your wound goes white in the night.
The Spectrals touch you through me.
A crack opens in the bone waste.

lines.zh: 血肉平原的雾里多了个影子。
lines.en: A shadow joins the flesh plains' mist.
A soft sound comes from beneath bedrock.

lines.zh: 你的注视把我召了下来。

lines.en: I climb out at the hole at zero, zero.

lines.zh: 噩梦从这片黑里结出来。
lines.en: Nightmare condenses out of this black.

lines.zh: 虚视者眨了下眼，我来了。
lines.en: The Spectrals blinked, and I came.
The night wind blew me into shape.
I am back to collect again.

lines.zh: 雷电击中虚无中的幻影！
